# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""独立复跑：复核 verify:dafeng:L1:0021 的每一条判据。退出码 0 == 全部成立。"""
import hashlib, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/Users/carmen/Desktop/星系')
import narrative

ROOT = '/Users/carmen/Desktop/星系'
SRC  = ROOT + '/data/cache/9b676d7031b1bcd3b8377a18.docs.json'
CAND = ROOT + '/loop/state/out/read_dafeng_L1_0021.candidate.json'
VERD = ROOT + '/loop/state/out/verify_dafeng_L1_0021.verdict.json'
S, E = 65082, 68044
SRCH = 'fdde555867aaccc2e676da9e9f3afecceab5d56114ae3e236af089e712539839'

raw = open(SRC, 'rb').read()
TEXT = json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'))[0]['text']
SEG = TEXT[S:E]
spans = narrative.chapter_spans(TEXT)

def chap(off):
    for sp in spans:
        if sp['start'] <= off < sp['end']:
            return sp
    return None

bad = []
def ck(name, cond, extra=''):
    print('%-58s %s %s' % (name, 'OK' if cond else '**BAD**', extra))
    if not cond:
        bad.append(name)

ck('file sha256 == task sourceHash', hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == SRCH)
ck('slice head == unit title', SEG.startswith('第二十二章 教公子一个道理'))
ck('slice len == 2962', len(SEG) == 2962)

# 1) 候选全量引用
cand = json.load(open(CAND, encoding='utf-8'))
refs = []
def walk(o, p='$'):
    if isinstance(o, dict):
        if 'quote' in o and 'start' in o and 'end' in o:
            refs.append((p, o))
        for k, v in o.items():
            walk(v, p + '.' + str(k))
    elif isinstance(o, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(o):
            walk(v, p + '[%d]' % i)
walk(cand)
nbad = 0
for p, o in refs:
    q, st, en = o['quote'], o['start'], o['end']
    if TEXT[st:en] != q: nbad += 1
    if o.get('sourceHash') != SRCH: nbad += 1
    if o.get('offsetUnit') != 'codepoint': nbad += 1
    inside = S <= st and en <= E
    if inside and SEG.count(q) != 1: nbad += 1
    if not inside and SEG.count(q) != 0: nbad += 1
ck('candidate refs: 0 mismatches (n=%d)' % len(refs), nbad == 0, 'bad=%d' % nbad)
ck('candidate refs count == 145', len(refs) == 145)

# 2) 本复核自己的每条引证都逐字
verd = json.load(open(VERD, encoding='utf-8'))
vrefs = []
def walk2(o):
    if isinstance(o, dict):
        if 'quote' in o and 'start' in o and 'end' in o:
            vrefs.append(o)
        for v in o.values(): walk2(v)
    elif isinstance(o, list):
        for v in o: walk2(v)
walk2(verd)
vbad = [o['quote'][:30] for o in vrefs if TEXT[o['start']:o['end']] != o['quote'] or TEXT.count(o['quote']) < 1]
ck('verdict refs verbatim (n=%d)' % len(vrefs), not vbad, str(vbad[:3]))

# 3) CE1：靠山那句在第二十九章，不在第二十七章
off = TEXT.find('我听说，户部侍郎周显平是他们的靠山。')
c = chap(off)
ck('CE1: 靠山句 offset == 87991', off == 87991, 'off=%d' % off)
ck('CE1: 靠山句在第二十九章', c['head'].startswith('第二十九章'), c['head'])
c27 = TEXT[79616:82180]
ck('CE1: 第二十七章 周显平==0', c27.count('周显平') == 0)
ck('CE1: 第二十七章 靠山==0', c27.count('靠山') == 0)
ck('CE1: 第二十七章 税银==0', c27.count('税银') == 0)
ck('CE1: 认罪书确实在第二十七章',
   chap(TEXT.find('因为在街上与周立发生口角，起了杀心，依仗武力出手害人，重伤了周立。'))['head'].startswith('第二十七章'))

# 4) CE2：叙述层未直述马死（引文里无「马死/马被杀」的叙述）
ck('CE2: T1 id 含 kills_the_horse', 'kills_the_horse' in cand['tasks'][0]['id'])
ck('CE2: U1 标 unresolved', cand['unknowns'][0]['basis'] == 'unverified')
ck('CE2: 原文有 撞飞了马匹 且区间内唯一', SEG.count('身子倾斜，肩背撞飞了马匹。') == 1)

# 5) 反向验证 7 条的引文都在区间内且逐字
rq = ["匕首不在此列，这群人算是钻了法律的空子。",
      "包围着许玲月的扈从不再搭理她，奔向了锦衣公子哥。",
      "许七安拱手，忍着脾气，好言好语：",
      "许二叔是军伍出身，许七安耳濡目染之下，一眼便认出了这匹马的品级。",
      "百姓们一哄而散，躲到远处看热闹。",
      "坚挺的膝盖骨砸在手臂上，火辣辣的疼。",
      "见扈从迟迟拿不下许七安，锦衣公子皱了皱眉，站在远处，冷嘲热讽："]
for q in rq:
    st = TEXT.find(q)
    ck('R quote in-range+unique: %s' % q[:16], S <= st and st + len(q) <= E and TEXT.count(q) == 1)

# 6) R5 那句确实落在候选未覆盖的补集里
ivs = sorted((o['start'], o['end']) for _, o in refs if S <= o['start'] and o['end'] <= E)
merged = []
for st, en in ivs:
    if merged and st <= merged[-1][1]: merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], en)
    else: merged.append([st, en])
g5 = TEXT.find('百姓们一哄而散，躲到远处看热闹。')
covered = any(a <= g5 and g5 + 16 <= b for a, b in merged)
ck('R5: 百姓围观句**未**被候选引文覆盖', not covered)

# 7) 内部交叉引用无悬空
ids = set()
for k in ['tasks','causeEdges','rejectedCauseEdges','states','knowledgeGaps','foreshadows',
          'rejectedForeshadows','openThreads','unknowns']:
    for it in cand.get(k) or []:
        if isinstance(it, dict) and it.get('id'): ids.add(it['id'].split('_')[0])
import re
used = set()
blob = json.dumps(cand, ensure_ascii=False)
for m in re.finditer(r'\b(RF\d|R\d|C\d|T\d|S\d|K\d|F\d|O\d|U\d)\b', blob):
    used.add(m.group(1))
ck('内部交叉引用无悬空', used <= ids, 'dangling=%s' % sorted(used - ids))

# 8) 中文事实
ck('区间内 周立==0', SEG.count('周立') == 0)
ck('区间内 户部侍郎==0', SEG.count('户部侍郎') == 0)
ck('区间内 周显平==0', SEG.count('周显平') == 0)
ck('区间内 头儿==0', SEG.count('头儿') == 0)
ck('全文 雪蹄==2', TEXT.count('雪蹄') == 2)
ck('全文 皮皮虾==1', TEXT.count('皮皮虾') == 1)
ck('全文 你知道我是谁==2', TEXT.count('你知道我是谁') == 2)

# 9) 结论字段
ck('verdict == partial', verd['verdict'] == 'partial')
ck('counterExamples 非空且都带 quote', bool(verd['counterExamples']) and all('quote' in c for c in verd['counterExamples']))
ck('reverseChecks >= 3', len(verd['reverseChecks']) >= 3)
ck('semanticReview 未越权', cand['reviewStatus']['semanticReview'] == 'not-performed')

print()
print('bad =', len(bad))
for b in bad: print('   !', b)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
